title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 2 Clause 30 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 2 Clause 30 - Heads of Income Heads of Income.— Save as otherwise provided in this Act, for the purpose of levy of income-tax and computation of total income, any income shall be classified under any of the following categories, namely: (a) income from employment; (b) income from rent; (c) income from agriculture; (d) income from business; (e) capital gains; (f) income from financial assets; (g) Income from other sources.
